limitations.finding: The205–294token compact preflight text is different from the actual full-catalog choice prompt. Actual inspected inputs_v2.build_messages uses pilot_v1.SYSTEM, which explicitly allows replacement or repeat purchase when requested.
limitations.action: Replacement-prefix concern resolved by actual source inspection; do not use compact preflight token counts for full training prompt or claim a new full-prompt tokenizer check from this audit.
